body.statement: Does the fuzzy-Hermite construction imply that every union-honest interval with \(L_G(C_n)\lesssim d_n\) satisfies \(L_N(C_n)\gtrsim d_n^-\) when \(\delta_n\lesssim s_n\) and \(L_N(C_n)\gtrsim\min\{d_n^-,B_n/\delta_n\}\) when \(\delta_n/s_n\to\infty\)? Success is uniformity over the projected experiments and supplied-fit set defining \(\mathcal A_n\).
body.justification: The question exposes the unbuilt converse rather than asserting a promissory lower bound.
body.gap: Cai and Low do not calculate this learned-residual PLM frontier, while fixed-separation ACE and the sibling spectral paper supply neither a shrinking-separation selector nor an expected-length converse.
body.consumer: Its resolution supplies the rate benchmark for every cumulant-adaptive interval.
